title: trachylobium floribundum
intro: Trachylobium floribundum, commonly known as the African walnut, is a plant species belonging to the family Leguminosae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with benefits including the ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, making it a potential natural remedy for cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
